verdicts_or_reports.screen: My Tasks task list (Sort sheet: Grouping None, Sorting By title Descending)
verdicts_or_reports.element: Task row "Buy milk" (first row of list)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Sorting "By title" and direction "Descending", the task list should be reverse-alphabetical: Read docs, Pay rent, Pack for trip, Buy milk.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The sort sheet shows "Sorting - By title - Descending", but the list stays alphabetical ascending: Buy milk, Pack for trip, Pay rent, Read docs. Toggling the direction control only changes the label; the order never reverses. (With "By due date" the direction does reverse the list, so it is specific to title sorting.)
steps: Open My Tasks and tap the Sort button.
Set Sorting to By title, then tap the Ascending/Descending control so it shows Descending.
Close the sort sheet and inspect the task order.
Reorder check: the subtitle still says Descending but the list is Buy milk, Pack for trip, Pay rent, Read docs.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: My Tasks task list, grouped by "List"
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Grouping by List should show every task under its list; all six tasks (Buy milk, Pack for trip with subtasks, Pay rent, Read docs, Link test, AAA test) belong to Default list, so all should appear under the Default list header.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With Grouping = List, only two tasks are listed under the "Default list" header: Link test and AAA test. Buy milk, Pack for trip (and its subtasks), Pay rent and Read docs disappear from the list, although they are shown ungrouped and their edit screens all show "Default list".
steps: Open My Tasks and tap the Sort button.
Set Grouping to List and close the sheet.
Only the Default list header with Link test and AAA test is shown; the four other tasks are gone.
Open the Sort sheet, set Grouping to None, close it: all six tasks reappear.
Set Grouping back to List: the four tasks vanish again.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: My Tasks task list (Grouping None, Sorting "By title" Ascending)
verdicts_or_reports.element: Task row "Apple pie" (last row of the list)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Sorting = By title Ascending, the list should be alphabetical (case-insensitive): Apple pie, aardvark, Buy milk, Pack for trip, Pay rent, Read docs, Zebra.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The list is left in creation order and title sorting never repositions the newly created tasks: Buy milk, Pack for trip, Pay rent, Read docs, aardvark, Zebra, Apple pie. A task named "Apple pie" is shown last instead of first, and "aardvark" (lower case) stays after the older tasks. The sort sheet confirms "Sorting - By title - Ascending"; switching lists and back or re-applying the sort does not change the order.
steps: In My Tasks, open the Sort sheet, set Grouping to None and Sorting to By title Ascending.
Create a new task named "Apple pie" (no due date, Default list) and save it.
Observe the list: Apple pie is appended at the very bottom, after Zebra, instead of being first alphabetically.
Re-open the Sort sheet: it still shows Grouping None / Sorting By title / Ascending.
Navigate to another list and back, or toggle the sort: Apple pie still stays at the bottom, so By title is not sorting these tasks by name.
